en.headline: Clinics face March deadline to use listed injectable devices
en.dek: Licensed private healthcare facilities must use only MDACS-listed injectable and infusible medical devices from 1 March 2027, the Department of Health said.
body: The Department of Health has told licensed private healthcare facilities that injectable and infusible medical devices used on their premises must be listed under the Medical Device Administrative Control System from 1 March 2027.

In a letter dated 9 September to licensees and applicants, the department said the requirement covers injectable dermal fillers and injectable mucous membrane fillers, among other injectable and infusible devices. The change was endorsed by the Advisory Committee for Regulatory Standards for Private Healthcare Facilities.

The department said it intends to publish revised codes of practice for private hospitals, day procedure centres and clinics in the Gazette in the fourth quarter of 2026. Most of the revised codes will take effect one month after publication; the listing rule for injectable and infusible devices will take effect on 1 March 2027 to give operators time to source compliant products.

The Medical Device Administrative Control System is the department’s existing listing scheme for medical devices. Operators who cannot confirm that a product is listed were advised to check the department’s published lists before the deadline.

zh.headline: 私營醫療機構明年三月起須用表列注射器械
zh.dek: 衞生署規定，持牌私營醫療機構由2027年3月1日起，只可使用已在醫療器械行政管理制度表列的注射及輸注醫療器械。
body: 衞生署已向持牌私營醫療機構表明，院所使用的注射及輸注醫療器械，由2027年3月1日起必須已在醫療器械行政管理制度（MDACS）表列。
署方在9月9日致持牌人及申請人的信中表示，有關要求涵蓋注射用真皮填充劑及黏膜填充劑等注射及輸注器械。修訂已獲私營醫療機構規管標準諮詢委員會通過。
衞生署打算於2026年第四季在憲報刊登經修訂的私家醫院、日間醫療中心及診所實務守則。除注射及輸注器械相關條文外，修訂守則將於刊憲後一個月生效；表列規定則於2027年3月1日生效，讓機構有時間購置合規產品。
醫療器械行政管理制度是衞生署現行的器械表列機制。署方呼籲營辦商在限期前核對公布名單，確認所用產品是否已表列。
